reasons: The cited text satisfies every element of the preferred position: § 22.1 caps audits at once in any twelve-month period, requires 30 days' prior written notice, normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable, and an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.

§ 22.2 allocates audit costs to Vendor unless an underpayment exceeding five percent is established, matching the preferred 5% threshold, and expressly prohibits Vendor/auditor direct access to Customer systems, avoiding the walk-away trigger.

The deterministic 'audit frequency limited: false' signal is correctly identified as a false negative; the operative language in p0082 plainly limits frequency, and the rationale explains the discrepancy rather than ignoring it.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed, so the output is consistent with the claimed status and retained as internal evidence only.
